output-never-outruns-evidence.statement: A rendered artifact may never be more precise, more certain, or more causal than the fact behind it. A crisp axis is a precision claim; an arrow is a causal claim; a chart launders confidence unless the confidence propagates into the drawing. Every figure on screen must trace to a sourced fact, and the fact's grade caps the rendering.

unmeasured-is-not-pass.statement: A quality gate may never report pass for something it did not check. "Unmeasured" is a first-class verdict, distinct from pass and fail, and enforcement coverage — what fraction of the promise is actually checked — is reported alongside the verdict. Craft parameters ship only with measurements behind them; an impression is not a number.

causality-over-sequence.statement: Between any two adjacent beats of a factual narrative you must be able to say "but" or "therefore". If the only honest connector is "and then", the beats have no causal relationship and what you have is a list, not a story. The same facts arranged causally give the viewer a reason to stay; arranged sequentially they give a reason to leave. Every structural choice — engine, act architecture, frame order — inherits this test.

edit-do-not-regenerate.statement: Once a creator has reviewed work, feedback is answered with the smallest set of edits — never a regeneration. A regenerated artifact voids every review, gate, and verification computed against the version it silently replaced, even when it is "better". Touch what the notes are about; leave everything else byte-identical.

checkability-routes-the-pixel.statement: If a viewer could check an element against a fact, deterministic code must draw it. If it only has to feel right, a model may. Charts, exact values, and labels are drawn and composited; atmosphere and illustrative scenes are generated. A generated glyph is not a nicer glyph — it is an unusable one.

style-is-restated-not-remembered.statement: Visual consistency across many generation calls comes from restating the full style contract on every call. Reference images alone measurably drift within a single batch; there is no short form, and no call may opt out of the style half of its prompt.

refusal-is-a-state.statement: Generative providers refuse, and a refusal is a routing decision: re-route to another provider or surface it honestly — never blind-retry the same request, and never let a refusal masquerade as an empty success. No elimination is silent; the trail of who declined and why is part of the output.

cost-per-usable-output.statement: Generation economics are computed over usable outputs, not renders. A cheaper render that fails the brief more often is the more expensive plate; price per usable unit inverts price per call often enough that the naive metric misroutes real money.
